name: App me als je thuis bent
original_name: App me als je thuis bent
overview: In the painfully topical documentary series "App Me When You're Home," women break their silence about the impact of similar street violence. Past and present sexual offenses reveal how deeply these crimes have affected women's lives. They discuss the loneliness of being around others, preferring to avoid judgment: "Why didn't you scream? Why didn't you run?" And self-reproach: "What was I even doing there so late in my life?"
